commit.message:
fix(browser): sentinel worker crashed at require time under ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE — unpack asar closure + path resolver + exit-code telemetry

Live-host root cause (Windows, v0.6.6-dev.15.1): worker_script resolved to
resources/app.asar/src/browser-sentinel-worker.cjs, but ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE
runs the Electron binary as vanilla Node which cannot load modules from an
asar archive. The worker died at require time every generation — 1177
worker recovery generations in ~65 minutes, each ending in
CANDIDATE_CONFIRMED_ABSENT — so waitUntilHealthy never succeeded,
host_resilience stayed DEGRADED_SENTINEL and self-update restart was
blocked with host_resilience_sentinel_not_ready_for_expected_restart.
(An earlier 50-minute CANDIDATE_ALIVE_HEARTBEAT_AMBIGUOUS stall was the
same instant exit plus Windows pid reuse.)

- electron-builder.test.json: asarUnpack the sentinel worker require
  closure (browser-sentinel-worker.cjs, browser-sentinel-liveness.cjs,
  browser-sentinel-action-journal.cjs, durable-json-file.cjs).
- host-resilience-runtime.mjs: resolveSentinelWorkerScript maps the asar
  path onto app.asar.unpacked when present (both separators), falls back
  to the original path in dev mode; no new authority, same spawn contract.
- browser-sentinel.mjs: worker recovery telemetry now records the exact
  child exit code and signal for both the old worker and the candidate
  (exact_child_exit_observed:exit_code:N / CANDIDATE_CONFIRMED_ABSENT
  ... :exit_code:N) — this class of defect becomes directly visible in
  state snapshots instead of churning silently.
- Tests (6): resolver mapping/fallback/dev-path/posix; asarUnpack closure
  guard; REAL vanilla-node spawn from a simulated app.asar.unpacked layout
  proving the closure loads and heartbeats under the RUN_AS_NODE regime
  (with parent-side pid binding fence simulated); exit-code telemetry.
  Full suite 1062 pass / 0 fail (2 pre-existing skips); check green.
